claims.claim: buildFilter filters statuses with the arrow function `(s) => s === STATUS_SUCCESS`, whose parenthesised single argument violates the repo rule arrow-parens: as-needed and makes `npm run lint` exit 1.

GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportHandler pages with find(filter).sort(sort).limit(limit).skip(cursor) and returns nextCursor = cursor + limit, i.e. offset pagination over a sort that has no _id tie-breaker, so rows inserted during the export or ties on the sort field can duplicate or drop rows between chunks.

QueryHandlerFactory registers GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportQuery to the Mongo handler unconditionally, before and outside the getTransHisExportSource() === 'postgres' branch that switches the other trans-his export handlers.
PartnerUserReserveExport.getRequiredModelName returns the literal array ['TransHisModel', 'MerchantModel'] instead of spreading transHisModelNames() as trans-his.export.ts does.
buildFilter splits params.status with String(params.status).split(',') and does not trim the parts, while statusAfter parts are trimmed with .map(s => s.trim()).
ExceedDateRangeValidator only checks dateDiff <= MAX_DAYS_EXPORT and therefore accepts a dateTo earlier than dateFr (negative dateDiff).
getConfig builds fileName with moment().format('DD-MM-YYYY') without .utcOffset(7), whereas transformRow formats createdAt with moment(item.createdAt).utcOffset(7).
reserveBalance computes the balance after as `before - amount` or `before + amount` on JavaScript numbers produced by toNumber(Number(raw)).
safeText prefixes a single quote to any text starting with =, +, -, @, tab or CR, and transformRow wraps every free-text column with safeText.
The merchant lookup in GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportHandler is wrapped in try/catch and on failure only logs a warning via mainProcess.logger?.warn.
buildSort treats the strings 'ASC' and 'ascend' as ascending sort directions.
GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportHandler calls TransHis.countDocuments(filter) on every page, including when cursor is greater than zero.
